# Create Custom Reports Key features Creating a custom report Available functional objects

_Last updated: Apr 20, 2026, 11:58 PM (Last updated 6 days ago)_

The Custom Reports feature provides on-demand access to data across both **Screen** and **Interview**. Use this feature to create, preview, save, and export tailored reports based on your organization's reporting needs.

The Custom Reports feature is available to:

- All admin users by default.

- Any user with access to the **Insights** tab on the HackerRank platform.

# Key features

Custom Reports offer the following features:

- **Create, preview, and save reports:**

  - Select only the columns that align with your reporting goals.

  - Hover over tooltips to understand what each column represents.

  - Preview the results before saving the report.

- **Combine business objects:**

  - Combine data from multiple objects (for example, Tests, Candidate Test Attempts & Invites).

  - View unified insights in a single report.

<!-- -->

- **Export as Excel:**

  - Export reports instantly in Excel format.

  - Access saved reports anytime that is available to all admin users.

<!-- -->

- **Copy and share reports:**

  - Modify or duplicate existing reports without starting from scratch.

  - Share reports via email to collaborate across teams or departments.

<!-- -->

- **Filter by columns:** Apply filters (for example, Test Name, Attempt Start Time) to refine report content and focus on relevant data.

- **Shared admin access:** All admin users can view, edit, and re-download saved reports, which helps streamline collaboration.

# Creating a custom report

To create a custom report:

![custom reportsnew.gif](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1769068330381-customreportsnew.gif?Expires=253370764800&Signature=JkaG59UiuJKZlmNMT5LMO8s-L6DAnhoJMmBGvxggvQ8c3~ZgANtcRCLV7wZUgMRPcrOEFD8yTASQaIwAOA6PtZYDgMrYdUbibjKBos4ih251DHNFrG-KseS2ybBhftLr5jAYKR~irZ~nZI9v1WRIrmES4d4OPxk-Qw~tWl8vDqTTbEE4lwzw7yrS3X2vDWpGA-V~wz3tCyVzo7l0PYbihxH6NVOTsIazizZivOyQA82teFBhIH9RwW0w2lgVQq5qXQNlMwTrhBTyEHMhO4jTUcXa-aFXK0i8B7E2m5Ihb-pzcdGHV2~KtmsvQ2jZGPlss2AWV8tZyorPBd~6vWr5GA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

1.  Log in to **HackerRank for Work** using your credentials.

2.  Go to the **Insights** tab.

3.  In the left panel, select **My Reports** under **Reports** section

4.  Click **Create Report**

5.  Select the required fields for your report:

    1.  Use the search bar or expand categories (for example, Tests, Candidate Test Attempts & Invites) to find relevant columns.

    2.  Click the **plus (+)** icon next to the relevant field to add it to the report.

**Note:** Use the tooltips (ⓘ) beside each field to view its description, or refer to the Available Functional Objects section below to see all fields and their descriptions.

1.  Preview the data in the right-hand panel. The preview table displays up to 20 rows.

2.  (Optional) Apply filters to refine the data.

    ![ARTICLE REPORT 1.gif](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1769066824357-ARTICLEREPORT1.gif?Expires=253370764800&Signature=cCbiyRsFgtgHRu-~zvyyEmBXEoNSWjN49PYEo5vGwMzH~GYHsEPjflX5qZMmYfVaP8eN~lLU5lkiIzvjTwjZVFisstSTmMYtY52CW1VHy80N1ksFIy5k3Y-4JOyRxSeELdGelW~B~4uW~xjyE~rG3j~3I486dyADvRCVTO~wba5YEWBt8QEUA8RPvAsXqqHC4c76Z8wOApWd1dl1AAIGY2JXz1zA~T9DWbl~H0a64Cu1PfRHdCNn5YzBBjjsNjdODqqU6smHk3PxlVe~l1WJGxCp4F~28yJ460hWEcoTB5nD-0VXj3PX40lgVWZJxmMCYfAAkT7itIJBoR3bfaVvXw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

    3.  Choose one or more aggregation functions.

4.  Click **Save** to store the report for future access.

5.  Click **Export** to download the complete report as an Excel file.

# Available functional objects

When creating a custom report, you can choose from the following objects:

- Tests

- Candidate Test Attempts and Invites

- Candidate Question Attempt

- Interviews

- Questions

- Users

These objects allow you to include data such as candidate names, test scores, question attempts, and other relevant metrics—all in one report.

The following sections provide tables that list the fields and their descriptions for each functional object.

# API Overview

_Last updated: Nov 22, 2025, 1:33 AM (Last updated 5 months ago)_

HackerRank offers robust APIs to automate test administration and result retrieval. Seamlessly integrate these APIs with your HR systems or create custom dashboards to streamline workflows. Additionally, explore our pre-built integrations with leading Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS). Refer to our [📄 Integrations Overview](/articles/1847021717)article for more details.

## Generating my API Token

Each enterprise user with a **HackerRank for Work** account can use our APIs to generate a personal access token. These APIs help automate repetitive tasks, such as administering tests and fetching results.

**Note**: This token is not intended to support ATS integrations. To obtain API keys for integrations with ATS platforms like Breezy, Lever, Greenhouse, or Jobvite, refer to the **ATS Integration** section in our knowledge base.

#### Steps to Generate an Access Token

- Click the **arrow** next to the user icon in the top-right corner of the **Home** page and then click on **Settings**.

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735207710006-1735207351793-1735206765435-image.png-f458ef41-fe8a-4059-bd42-df7821ab3c5a-59f0a144-3e46-4134-9e3c-b39e3a88ec8e?Expires=253370764800&Signature=i8qJdkA9aH3IoMZ-5e5mCosx7JPT~Hnma6NDTnfEF04I-SbFY9oXzJriCaWIfLMLEhuFYNMz6gyd10NXS8-jJpUfIDl5D-k9EplxI9aMPEIQe43zemSyzi~LHSw1PxW6MdaV71p5E5-F8bDufewagvryvYh-6mqZr0TF2EQJBQqtIQWEnUNkvQl8qyQm-YeV4YYJcnN28K89VBgFQ3ObcdEnzsM956SAOdrvp9HDEn2nAFt0WT07DeJ9fVkwDWdOl-4~RKle9~3a0P-6sqwubPeUaaU1LhXNJh0XvGFd09Iu2aeQYjnBcAVORh1qLoMvSEip3BrGSFtWTpN1Y9cVNA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

- On the **API** page, click **New Token**.

- In the **New Token** dialog box:

  - Enter a label for the token.

  - Click **Generate Token**.

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735207697884-1735207352303-1735206943076-image.png-50e74835-dd94-4722-9f91-d3fd3bbe5ca7-f9e213ef-d114-4aae-af2d-ab1eed22877f?Expires=253370764800&Signature=mTlwRbCphb-9gh4RIcRthgYQg9Gj-ASAOUnZb6htO-89vIaviYfFKyEPMjcSujJtOwNI0cv9QxDBVQCw1Z2xmqtDpzAzYzuehCzwyij39j4c~X0PYxleogcOOU8Vp9Ah-t32dbw6K4qt4bui3nBlLbvPq0y6W-Bq0yzC5PMzDz~fVMOIuVWH2iXSR5-XqnIEfMypZynKqOnf606PoNjT1RdJq4zYm9Zbk3o4~4hZPke4He7xcX9QBDnv3dUTNRsohWHxRqTmZQTLHmbh-hW3dBBBPARtYve2mMTZDmEjsFXNJbEkRuTgnAoxj-0mhrXVERmUPTOz9ifc9K2nw-txMg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

- The newly generated token will be displayed. You can use the options provided to copy, edit, or delete it.

**Tip**: Refer to our detailed [API Documentation](https://www.hackerrank.com/work/apidocs#!/Introduction/options_intro_api) for more information about API usage and capabilities.

## Rate limits

HackerRank recommends sending up to 10 API requests per second. If you exceed this rate, the API returns a 429 (Too Many Requests) error. Monitor these errors and retry failed requests when necessary.

If you need to send more than 10 API requests per second, contact [support@hackerrank.com](mailto:support@hackerrank.com).

text:
# Candidate Status in API Results Status ATS state

_Last updated: Feb 23, 2026, 12:46 PM (Last updated 2 months ago)_

When you retrieve candidate data using the HackerRank API, the JSON response includes two integer fields:

- `status`

- `ats_state`

# Status

The `status` field represents the state of the candidate’s test attempt.

## Stable values

The table below lists the stable values and their descriptions.

|           |                                                 |
|-----------|-------------------------------------------------|
| **Value** | **Description**                                 |
| `-1`      | Candidate invited                               |
| `0`       | Candidate session in progress                   |
| `1`       | Candidate completed the test; reports not ready |
| `7`       | Reports ready for consumption                   |

**Note:** You can build downstream logic only on the stable values.

## Transient values

The API may return values such as `2–6` or other negative numbers.

These values represent intermediate processing stages, such as:

- Evaluation

- Integrity checks

- Report generation

Transient values are not part of the API contract and may change without notice. Do not build downstream logic that depends on them.

# ATS state

The `ats_state` field represents the candidate’s stage in the recruitment workflow.

After a candidate completes a test:

- The system updates the state automatically if you configure a cut-off score.

- A recruiter can manually update the state to move the candidate forward in the hiring process.

## ATS state values

The table below lists the `ats_state` values and their corresponding recruitment stages:

|           |                                      |
|-----------|--------------------------------------|
| **Value** | **ATS State**                        |
| `0`       | ATS state not set                    |
| `1`       | Test Completed – Evaluation Required |
| `2`       | Test Completed – Qualified           |
| `3`       | Test Completed – Failed              |
| `4`       | Phone Interview – I                  |
| `5`       | Phone Interview – II                 |
| `6`       | Phone Interview – III                |
| `7`       | Offer Sent                           |
| `8`       | Offer Negotiation                    |
| `9`       | Offer Accepted                       |
| `10`      | Offer Declined                       |
| `11`      | On Hold                              |
| `12`      | Phone Interview – Cleared            |
| `13`      | Phone Interview – Failed             |
| `14`      | Technical Interview – Cleared        |
| `15`      | Technical Interview – Failed         |
| `16`      | HR Interview – Cleared               |
| `17`      | HR Interview – Failed                |
| `18`      | Phone Interview                      |
| `19`      | Technical Interview                  |
| `20`      | HR Interview                         |
| `21`      | Hired                                |
| `22`      | Rejected                             |

text:
# Skills on HackerRank

_Last updated: Aug 23, 2025, 11:34 AM (Last updated 8 months ago)_

HackerRank helps customers standardize their hiring process by providing them with specifically curated skill-based content to test candidates. Additionally, interviewers and evaluators can add their feedback on specific skills through scorecards.

## How Can Skills Help Companies?

With skills, users on HackerRank can now use [Roles](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/9675847328-getting-started-with-roles-management) to create Tests and Interviews. Each Role, in turn, has one or more skills mapped to it. Based on skills captured inside a role, the platform offers a seamless way to create tests using standard content and capture interviewers’ feedback on a structured scorecard.

See [HackerRank's Skills Directory](https://www.hackerrank.com/skills-directory) to know more about the list of available skills on our platform.

## Skill-Based Insights on Candidates

To get started with skill-based insights, you need to have two things in place.

1.  Create tests using skill-based questions. Click [here](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/7429771072-creating-a-test-based-on-a-specific-role) to know more. 

2.  Capture skill-based interviewer's feedback through Interview scorecard. Click [here](https://support.hackerrank.com/hc/en-us/articles/360048405234-Interview-Scorecards) to know more.

## Purpose of Skill-Based Insights

When HackerRank generates skill-based insights from a candidate's test or interview performance, it aggregates them into a skill summary report inside the candidate packet.

The candidate packet serves as a single source of truth for a candidate’s skills within HackerRank. It includes reports and scorecards from all assessments and interviews the candidate completes for a specific role.

The screenshot below shows a sample candidate packet.

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1755928294313-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=hgWbhLWIWEt2aR9X55WPVU2jKANnAosOTL~EPfN8XVohuWSU0EV~~lxwdZfCMqs7Cr3tw6X53fbQPRi0MWyTLdOPd-jd3~Gd-s-PYlpnekYbWMyYQTq0gu4JbzgmlZesfdxRzVyyYX7xiNdQ4z42wWOq-AxEiuuKR6d9-lIb3-WbsZr7yluDslLLFXkzD-bMjDZr0bQS3RNJMcGEKjXy81y97kjMwROwh-v2~KuSGPJeeT1FIF8LZXO1r9Sza7DttN9S3w9f1OQbgtcukuelSwx7Rww3Yl~IVDMnZq7gxsdubQgAjUwQRin3rMoUSqKTkV8-~btFdggshzjiG89ZSA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

text: # Getting Started with Roles Management _Last updated: Mar 5, 2025, 11:10 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_ ## Roles on HackerRank A **Role** represents a job position at an organization that is a collection of skills aligned with industry standards. HackerRank, guided by its **Skills Directory**, has curated high-quality questions mapped to these skills to assess candidates accurately. ### Roles Management The HackerRank for Work platform's Roles Management module provides a structured and customizable process for managing roles and streamlining the overall hiring workflow. ### Accessing Roles Management On the HackerRank platform, click the profile icon and select **Roles Management **from the dropdown. ### Default Roles HackerRank includes default roles pre-configured with essential skills based on market trends, user data, and subject matter expertise.  ### Custom Roles Custom roles allow organizations to tailor roles according to specific hiring needs. Only company admins can create roles within their accounts. Once created, these roles are available for all users in the organization. **Steps to Create a Custom Role:** - Click **Create Role**. - In the popup, provide a role name associate relevant skills, and save or - Use **Save to Draft button** to save the role without publishing it.  **Note**: Published roles cannot be edited. To make changes, archive the role and create a new one with the same name.

# Getting Started with Teams Management

_Last updated: Apr 29, 2025, 3:03 PM (Last updated 12 months ago)_

HackerRank’s **Teams Management** feature simplifies user organization and administration by enabling you to group employees (HackerRank users) into teams. This centralized approach helps manage operations, roles, and resources effectively.

### Prerequisites and Access

1.  **Company Admin Access**\
    You must have a **Company Admin** role to access the **Teams Management** section.

2.  **Navigating to Teams Management**

    - Click the **profile icon** in the top-right corner of the page.

    - Select **Teams Management** from the dropdown menu.

text: ### **User Management** This section allows admins to manage individual users within the organization. **Search and Filter Users** - Use the **Search** feature to locate users by name, email, or team. - Apply **User Role**, **Status**, and **Last Active** filters for refined searches. **Tip**: Use the **Last Active** filter to identify and assess inactive users within a specific time range. **Add Users**\ Admins can add new users using the **Add New User** button with the following options: 1. **Email Invite** - Enter the user’s name and email address. - Assign a **User Role** and team. - Click **Add** to send an invitation email. 1. **Link Invite** - Assign a **User Role** and team. - Generate and share a link that users can use to join the selected team. 1. **Bulk Invite** - Upload a CSV file with user details such as names and email addresses. - Users will receive invitations based on the uploaded data. - Download a sample CSV file for format reference. **Transfer Ownership** - Transfer resources like tests from one user to another. - Click the **three-dot icon** next to the user’s name, select **Remove from Teams**, and confirm the new owner. ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735274401458-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=tnb7eaRQdtdbqGpIO4Ym35up2BqvKlNZXbeCy14n9fUUBcLaiIvtswpNzr1sjymQ1hR7gZ25zD-Qgd6gMFxmsgWgoryY3U3OombpolkTTpqesPDHAp2FFGR6l6JK1ollgvQMCoxyiliDEZjMy7kHLaPgYeqQea7WpTs8U1ilNoozMXyN9i3QD1qS0kES0MCEMppDAK9v42N0h6UAgB7IR6fJ5nDIENm9I1EZKwpeAGoLCP3hUXddnCpxyjJq-muWxVpz2EKIu~HV-QMFsIYhyXp23iEzh0MzvY-F-lrzxgmq6KeXXZJrecxPpRIkQTmfmKwXocSJReNaa3LF6VvdFg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46) **Bulk User Management**\

text:
### **Team Level Management**

This section focuses on organizing and managing teams.

**Search and Filter Teams**\
Use the **Search** bar and filters such as **Region** and **Department** to find specific teams.

**Create a Team**

1.  Click **Create Team**.

2.  Enter the team’s details, including name, region, and department. The **Region** and **Department** fields are optional.

3.  Select team members and click **Add**.

**Set Default Invitation Settings**\
Hover over a team name and click the **three-dot icon** to:

- Configure **Send Invite As** to customize the sender name for team invitations.

- Set a default logo for the team to appear in all communications.

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735275060446-1735275028328-image.png-8ba3b8ad-5b91-4304-84d3-8542c0150071?Expires=253370764800&Signature=JFtcRUm~qZPMYNqe2aS3wt9OetUr~yC1TZ0fTdJcIMtx9SCSxKE4P3csNrJNFdVBqEzzJdNVeOF8D5LnUQ2ddrsaSpb8CsRZjCe4wto61RElT8qCiug0mcAySYeEFVEq77DiaHJnQ9mWXln0LmpgMPKXCT9DPwjePKZzz5bEGJsyjCFyMIhTW7Y7whVLYzxlFjxQxTs0jq9c~AEvEn-RE-54vSNj3dq3tLexMuD88yqh0frp7jqUXeuoenmXwxHYHfl944w8pLdQw3RjF~K5Q-ZafDxGgCnNr1Cj7pv0VJjOoEPTBHOs1CGCSHFk0ZhV0RdkKRN31489H5t5gYkOCw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

**Manage Teams**

- Open a team to update its membership and roles.

- Add or remove members and change their roles to **Team Admin** or **Member**.

**Delete a Team**

- Remove all members from the team before deletion.

- Select the team and click the **delete icon** to finalize the process.

# Delete a Team Prerequisite Deleting a team

_Last updated: Mar 31, 2026, 3:11 PM (Last updated 4 weeks ago)_

HackerRank allows you to delete an existing team.

# Prerequisite

You must have Company Admin or Team Admin access.

# Deleting a team

To delete a team:

1.  Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account using your credentials.

2.  Select your profile icon in the upper-right corner.

3.  Select **Teams Management** from the drop-down menu.

4.  Go to the **Teams** tab.

    ![teams.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1771855347626-teams.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=aRIQMr-hPeNv5o2Pcr43l~oNNloQK8svzCyzvDl6Kyig1vi29y~deSHuuRAws33356CeMSASjyXG-1Rg0X6diuAfgyt-7B5MRO5Kc6zmj~cbQnoGsnraRYFd6H8XIwJTHla-IlIRV276x74Dzg7atnwZqGHoCYcbqQw8Eex52~Nq1IEL4RQI837wxumhCKv2It5o~be3H4adwLMPJQLuWzx3XUvbvTt1ZxgzUKDyz29IjUZ5Nzjrcif-1n8jW~hajrPZw4nDdc66-deuWGZliIj3xGd5cbfpFqw5P~yelKRnB3IpmAkHRBEB8haw3vHTud2HJOIIL7vUL3p0Fa3QZw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

# Manage Team Members Prerequisite Managing team members

_Last updated: Mar 3, 2026, 3:30 PM (Last updated 2 months ago)_

HackerRank allows you to manage team members to control access and permissions. You can add or remove team members and update team member roles.

# Prerequisite

You must have Company Admin or Team Admin access.

# Managing team members

To manage team members:

1.  Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account using your credentials.

2.  Select your profile icon in the upper-right corner.

3.  Select **Teams Management** from the drop-down menu.

4.  Go to the **Teams** tab.

5.  Select the team you want to update. 

6.  Select the **Allocation** tab.

    ![update_team2.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F46c1e05e-89a4-464f-ad28-841c6290d0f1-1772519270719-update_team2.png-6fc53fdc-8607-4915-9844-48285792bd6f?Expires=253370764800&Signature=YPWWJxfinNg7Uffh4vvjVJYxd06DDrRSg-wWrMBUUktP4KGNkiglDaGoJJxu3DPYNB3DtgnZZwjDbECz8keYbz-nNwbUOoxWPQerg6fxN81JGK4d5bq9GGemUDvvHWHegsAIuMDX3oeLuxaA060dFgtnBSfl8UgVTZW6EwSsL3Jw655iELCMAtcXWEku6JdHUMnvtHnW3j-5vmGqfkxN3JJX8JT~ROTt61xk~WNK-u1LWPtT0FhafAuCEUjBrqvqfA3Ee00vO2w0F0gmN5US6nsUOd9VkkUgZWj7Jmz4gw2X8SyZ0cNKsgmAdmbt48Vn36INI3e5MDCATOPv4AJ-IA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

text: # Flexible User Roles Key features Entitlements Accessing flexible roles Available entitlements _Last updated: Mar 6, 2026, 12:16 AM (Last updated 2 months ago)_ HackerRank for Work enables administrators to manage user-level access using the Flexible User Roles feature. This feature provides granular control, allowing administrators to customize user entitlements based on organizational requirements. Flexible user roles help organizations improve productivity and efficiency while maintaining secure administrative oversight. # Key features The flexible user roles offer the following features: - **Align user roles with workflows**: Customize user roles to match specific responsibilities and processes, ensuring each user has the appropriate level of access and capabilities. - **Granular access control**: Manage user permissions precisely to protect sensitive data and maintain compliance with security policies. - **Adapt to change**: Adjust user entitlements easily as business processes evolve, allowing your organization to accommodate new requirements or role changes without operational disruption. # Entitlements Entitlements define the actions that users can perform within the platform. They control activities such as viewing, creating, updating, and deleting tests, interviews, and questions. **Note:** HackerRank offers four types of user roles. For more information about these roles and their default entitlements, see [Types of User Roles](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/9603546665). # Accessing flexible roles  To access flexible roles: 1. Log in to **HackerRank for Work** using your credentials. 2. Select your profile icon in the upper-right corner. 3. Select **Team Management** from the drop-down menu. 4. Go to the **User Roles** tab. ## Customizing user roles To customize a user role: 1. Select the role you want to customize. ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1772736319695-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=UE-hzVzu2XhuYKisSPxYTxxfYFexSXTGjp51TnlsfUYTR-3bdExOq0rbROIZLB2~WlCTEeweytPiCHerqQ7OubeUVX73CrfeYaTKj8zcfitZDIks9xX2zZV1y9hH4dePHXxMBs~DLgf0uQ41tTMBXvVeVJeIXQQVJJzZDwP6iiD--1tCRLVOWY0vvDPLEC0St9mxv9zzC5doAh3YIXX6y7i4IumxrmXbcPfVRlA~ugcn8VZGFRmbwS5Nmegd5GUflfIqT0dojpejaS5AbOFN13t9h33Y9Nh0kBoLGxNBG3~pOPfn7utGXx91-brRz1FidtrrJGIMjqnrpl1JunOljw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46) 2. Turn on or off each entitlement using the toggle switch next to it. 3. Scroll to the bottom of the page and click **Save Changes**.

# Prerequisite

# Modify entitlements for recruiters

To modify entitlements for recruiters in a team:

1.  Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account using your credentials.

2.  Select your profile icon in the upper-right corner.

3.  Select **Teams Management** from the drop-down menu.

# Set Team Logo and Sender Name Prerequisites Set a logo at the team Level Set a sender name at the team level

_Last updated: Mar 11, 2026, 3:49 PM (Last updated 2 months ago)_

You can set the logo and sender name for each team. The logo and sender name appear in all candidate invitation emails sent by users in that team.

# Prerequisites

- You must have created a team.

- You must have admin access to manage teams.

# Set a logo at the team Level

To set a logo at the team level:

1.  Log in to **HackerRank for Work** using your credentials.

2.  Select your profile icon in the upper-right corner.

3.  Select **Teams Management** from the drop-down menu.

4.  Select the **Teams** tab.

5.  Locate the team you want to update and click the three-dot menu next to it.

6.  Select **Set logo at team level**.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1764235962422-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=dyYqSPMtKIvjCeqxlcdcTeOgyhGtAH5iMHjnCPeXzwSr2W3YcfYwUdcM2DAFUhu-m6f~WEzliabyvZyj0n2IVtEbV07BGJKiN4DGKwEUIKOct-MC3hWPza19dPF-TTMDDT3iB3cTYE6l~20oyMAOQjAymGefAhW-Q5BetIE1W21scflG88nbV2pIx-RM5Uy89N8SSoFtzihIFmVOCN1SkFlhLHFJk1~9M3kwrSCqvoy0Z94TVok6y-Uh3dnP2TauitYY23MGd2XJY~puWsw469iZRL8tP4SpWawuepA7ECVyvPhA~YfhVVvDPuPdeeNlFAyWmR2hKe2VgQNCiyvmnw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

7.  In the **Set team logo** dialog box, choose an existing logo or upload a new one.

8.  Click **Set Logo**.

Your changes apply immediately.

# Set a sender name at the team level

To set a sender name at the team level:

1.  Log in to **HackerRank for Work** using your credentials.

2.  Select your profile icon in the upper-right corner.

3.  Select **Teams Management** from the drop-down menu.

4.  Select the **Teams** tab.

5.  Locate the team you want to update and click the three-dot menu next to it.

6.  Select **Send Invite as**.

7.  In the **Send Invite as** dialog box, enter the sender name you want candidates to see.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1764237109921-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=q5SSmGeQjjLg-whs3amw1rkXCCEle3UkJZs6Z-Q-lnpu0T71efqJufA~oCNgUhPIGHcKFAErwZrEsWFt1fn8zp5wLQ5k9C8e8oOLWRHXwHFKFEMvKRyeUl~zyixQX-cI0bHpj3BHOvdfYxsUaUKt1DV9JKVYY~WdbrhDzf-jCSWoAeRy~IsgdJlUNw5gsbXEf7DpYNdyNU957SVi6~-xTjXzFhWyPSVD5CrscnHLh8FIeJzbPBhx-CU3EIdlSzCWB9SEjk-ocFKUg0AqHZFD8ZuIEhHtmBIUZdW4NZSV4-ExOBxRLrt6wpLc7uK9-wlr6JmLvxhFzagbsql4iR5fOg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

8.  Click **Confirm**. All invitations sent from this team will display this sender name.

**Important Note:** If a user belongs to multiple teams, the sender name set at the team level does not apply.

# Lock User Access Prerequisite Locking user access Unlocking user access

_Last updated: Apr 23, 2026, 1:21 PM (Last updated 3 days ago)_

HackerRank for Work lets you lock user access to prevent users from accessing the platform. You can lock individual users or multiple users.

# Prerequisite

You have **Team Admin** or **Company Admin** access.

# Locking user access

To lock user access:

1.  Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account using your credentials.

2.  Select your profile icon in the upper-right corner.

3.  Select **Teams Management** from the drop-down menu.

4.  Go to the **Users** tab.

5.  Select one or more users.

6.  Click **More** and select **Lock.**

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1776060550901-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=Sg8ulJQHBAiYKXzGWLdfc4LtfIUN9nlgUEaesuDWpDM~4-s2fmVpZRUbZR-ItxZ0K4qrO0RcsGtMnWoh-eoLmrg~XvMxXg2JYt4-6O9RUGbGeVaxQE6MiLYsXnBDsBJLb7NL6XU6jw4ZqRdafUlnWdhS~-ISXeu0tSCkcZQ4ZFIXQkJjStoSdMB7Fqwb2BKecrvLpbImdtVMuw3aArG9MJdn3RtuUf0gFEU7Gf3kwz633wxy4quLXJypA3cdcFgLIH6E9kxjZTPLRzksMsB7zCkKHSN5tonw4oX-5hMYvvAHQdZFOUZLjZAE5NLTjQXc3RTribOydcPlS50YkAq1tg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

7.  In the **Lock Users** dialog:

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1776060571759-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=XZGFib~kdy6e-UUYsj17HXyQZ7wVSUx-acfP31~OFfkGWjRzNHNr7cAN4DcJO8qqUMeh3-L2SPFO1R8~GgJpqvu3W6XI2gtgjIGm~c2sy4Vxs9X4eFQdvOVEXEEbkJeKMNT5YJhueZOHNBQhqpIRnxHNKHwsBpZinHKawV6UHEqfIjxYPg~LI3VXCJJMF7xHAxXC6~9MFXGBHay6PCjAPltbbEc3SUb~noXCltkRSBQtDEdLUZZKTwDfv4rZNVWZAqKZYZKslWqBkXkrjMlGkyGZu9nebuFLWcW4e2YD3~7jvlo0oBfclq~aGfhsDD2mRyLZUo2FLehwAbzx05xnvg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

    1.  Select a user under **Transfer to** to transfer resource ownership. For more information, see [📄 Transfer Resource Ownership](/articles/8845665482).

    2.  Click **Confirm**.

The platform transfers resources and locks the selected users. The account remains available for reuse.\
Locked users cannot log in and see an error message if they attempt to access the platform. 

**Note:** If a user belongs to only one team, [removing the user](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/2203617737-manage-team-members#removing-a-team-member) from that team or [deleting the team](https://support.hackerrank.com/articles/2181136239-deleting-a-team) locks the user. 

# Unlocking user access

You can unlock a user account to restore access to the platform at any time.

To unlock user access:

1.  Go to the **Users** tab.

2.  Locate the user you want to unlock.

3.  Click the more options menu under **Actions**.

4.  Select **Unlock User.**

# Team Member Status

_Last updated: Dec 27, 2024, 11:15 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

HackerRank for Work allows you to categorize team members based on their current status, such as **Activated**, **Not Activated**, or **Locked**. A team member’s status indicates their position within the organization. You can search for team members by status, review their status, and take relevant actions as needed.

### Steps to Identify Team Member Status

1.  **Access Teams Management**

    - Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account.

    - Click the **arrow** next to the user icon in the top-right corner of the homepage.

    - Select **Teams Management** from the dropdown menu.

2.  **Navigate to the Users Tab**

    - On the **Teams Management** page, click the **Users** tab.

    - The page displays a list of all users and details such as team, region, and department.

3.  **Filter by Status**

    - Use the **Status** filter at the top of the page to refine the user list.

    - Select one of the following options from the dropdown:

      - **Activated**: Indicates that the user has activated their account using the activation email and is part of one or more teams.

      - **Not Activated**: Indicates that the user belongs to one or more teams but has not yet activated their account.

      - **Locked**: Indicates that the user is not part of any team and has no resources allocated.

4.  **View Users by Status**

    - Selecting any status option displays a list of users categorized under the chosen status.

heading: Overview
text: # Searching for a Team _Last updated: Dec 13, 2024, 5:11 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_ ## Overview HackerRank for Work enables you to search for a particular team for easy access to shared resources in the team. This article will walk you through the steps involved in searching for a team. ## Steps to Search a Team **Prerequisites** - You must be logged in to your HackerRank for Work account. **Steps** 1. On successfully logging into your HackerRank for Work account, click on the arrow next to the user icon on the top right corner of the homepage. This leads you to the **Teams Management** page. 2. On the displayed page, you can see the entire list of all teams in your company, along with the region, department, and so on of every team on the **Teams** tab. 3. On the search bar, type the name of the team you are searching for. 4. The team(s) that match the searched word(s) will appear on the right pane. 5. Click on the team name to view or edit team details.   Similarly, on the 'users' tab, you can easily search and view a particular user's details.

# Transfer Resource Ownership Prerequisite Transferring resource ownership

_Last updated: Mar 12, 2026, 2:44 PM (Last updated 1 month ago)_

HackerRank allows you to transfer ownership of all resources, such as tests and questions, from one user to another. Transferring ownership ensures that no critical content is lost during user transitions.

# Prerequisite

You must have Company Admin access.

# Transferring resource ownership

To transfer ownership of all resources:

1.  Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account using your credentials.

2.  Select your profile icon in the upper-right corner.

3.  Select **Teams Management** from the drop-down menu.

    ![team manage.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1773296082634-teammanage.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=D96UmGxJM1eXMMO-HO5QX7ohIeB9kgsDjknK03ehajE1ggRjzdVtbvLj-vqDp3mcaJ4yBv8mUpgMreGAsqz3jwzbvH2t-QRF22QD7ztz9DZGYgluEs5D5T-t9qvMSnhVJMGnB9DSFflV~G1e5rVRaTYr86xliaIIo6JGuZRI8MA5KiUGyEt6CmkMJHb~Z2REMJ8lhqEvkrdlr3Y-GkCvE3Ooyup1fY5jtmdFIxNn1~4sEchkZ8mWcSo5ZK~gVaQju1VlmyD9rC~W-WHytxYR9vKmOuR~C0k3MZoYHqzA-gaQ6FZ4fUGE-O~Anc-FubkufGDxNZd38M3~36d4b8xLxw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

4.  Locate the user whose resources you want to transfer in the **Users** tab.

5.  Click the more options menu under the **Actions** column.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1773296443065-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=cqPVkozyW~JC3ng4nrEi~4MUh7yygcgGnlTkJM6mgjPcAVAAW5Kd4VhXkomrLlL~OK3Tu82lna4akk~aQUlfEgtXijG3I56sGlvIyPMiXCLn~qaqJLoGP290v3PlrGnCx-VmuTleZ8dp6fuzU6CysQxEoFfg5xN~bNd345n5X4jEfc8INcEzZqlt6qcQCva3s90-akaSZpVGamezamnGVU8lZgzj1L5Hv4W9eUfODWbJPeE2Dr8Fx1QMczVJpgkLaGU5fc33pYTGA~RJruowdCXvLIljKlwjmm-fgsqoDUjBTvukvM4ru38n3MIxIhoHKEP1w72GIK0uXAkmfbMBqA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

6.  Select **Transfer Ownership.**

7.  In the **Transfer Resource Ownership** dialog:

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1773296519445-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=fjSyFUZfMEFtQt-GWI1IPB6bzR0YQkCip2aDtpgmv46RigOBqQ49r9ovV2SJdSHoqOs1zwRusSLHH505WVw4~FItiY5FhCKZvZlwmocqAv6B5QhT7ZNNHRPDzDk2GgeW6nPHNmHVQJ~KmtFb3C2WTQaZ213LZF35ORA607jImQQRLiCWqSw-7BttPB6Wm9xCfC1DcBn~ZBDSBhVbd4UT4FebGg48BIHbijb18nnW5OMmfE9QlL4Gz~a3LpA0tga0Yr0pVts3Qs68tkgEtlC~H9~NeXTXJFdpJYmKZZY9iQ5gWDGEXod52Z9ZqUOO399ReWfNDIh~TRi9NbSV4g3QaQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

# Create a Team Prerequisite Creating a team

_Last updated: Feb 23, 2026, 12:38 PM (Last updated 2 months ago)_

You can create teams in HackerRank to match your company structure. Members of a team can view all tests, interviews, and other resources created within that team.

# Prerequisite

You must have Company Admin access.

# Creating a team

To create a team:

1.  Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account using your credentials.

2.  Select your profile icon in the upper-right corner.

3.  Select **Teams Management** from the drop-down menu.

    ![teams.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1771823914511-teams.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=tlesipmu-AG7N0RpiENa3j3TyYGTL-0s5~WSnTxCSP7EH2OGXmrSRbBt~pqpQmv4GRL9mppvZHA7JACFO~RXLfgLM6rFnkC1vg6bIYosDmE3YesG1em6KDc0Djrh5RbrSsthfHTEcuHgU0tnDUSWg2bsEoRuhhzibdbyES7GrzyXl03bmntsncybdExz4F8lo35F4KXAo0sweQGlsxy4vkiV6PNou5nnLZToGtGl0zE~Z6-Enp-q8l43iLbqhG6zpBSnatdqM-DLNGz3jfdbd~69X~m4rdlUiKttGjgCQ4wXrZtA2E83jbmY67pngF05KOJzA8ipRtKkm11XtHu2xQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

6.  In the **Create Team** dialog, enter the following details:

    ![create_a_team_dialog.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1771824120626-create_a_team_dialog.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=lOzlmdvrKgptie5YwIlvDJwPcEaiItCdrDMzXJ6CSLdIzaWW6Qxq9HMUCn7-1dqqd88B0CMOyLovTtVAMhSujCC0n~vsJHsI1MyLm-NtvswX5LBGDYe6fnY0prRQyJM8ADim0ETqIAT4fvNujZDJv~MCTgOUVL5NgDYNLm88~STKFscJKubwSkBzCbyYfSpu4Rb6N-BjuuD69sqqlc7qx7vHLU0QKebseoSjjQvV-98AIu4E4dfcdaLYL7afBJSWjJ7Nfd5K93RghZLkBMaDfPF774I7txBk36ME0TkAiHHC9AC7FpCTg5vXttzrwl~x1hlt3b-2-qnezvx48KzrEg__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

    - **Team Name:** Name of the team you want to create.

    - (Optional) **Region**: Indicates where the team operates, such as a city, country, or geographic area (for example, APAC or EMEA).

    - (Optional) **Department**: Indicates the company division the team belongs to, such as Sales, Engineering, or Human Resources.

    - (Optional) **Add users**: Type or select the users from the drop-down menu.

# Invite a New User Prerequisite Inviting a new user

_Last updated: Feb 13, 2026, 3:36 PM (Last updated 2 months ago)_

You can invite new users to HackerRank for Work account and assign roles and team access.

**Note**: To add an existing user to a team, see [📄 Inviting an Existing User to a Team](/articles/2203617737).

# Prerequisite

text: # Types of User Roles _Last updated: Mar 26, 2025, 11:45 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_ HackerRank for Work offers four types of user roles, each granting different capabilities. - Company Admin  - Developer  - Interviewer  - Recruiter ## Company Admin  Company admins hold the highest level of access and control within the HackerRank platform. They oversee all company account aspects, including user management, billing, and settings. ### Key Responsibilities and Permissions - **User Management:** Company Admins have the authority to manage every user within the company's HackerRank account. This includes [inviting new users, assigning roles to the users](https://support.hackerrank.com/hc/en-us/articles/22181635545875-Teams-Management), modifying entitlements, and [locking/unlocking users](https://support.hackerrank.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001392787-Locking-User-Access-from-HackerRank) when necessary.   - **Team Management:** As a Company Admin, you can create, modify, and delete teams. You also have the power to assign Team Admins and manage team-specific settings. - **Access:** Company Admins can access all tests and interviews across the platform, regardless of which team created them. They also have complete access to questions, Interview templates, and candidate details on the platform. - **Setting Configuration:** Company Admins can configure all [company-wide settings](https://support.hackerrank.com/hc/en-us/sections/19074972214675-Company-Level-Admin-Settings), such as company name, brand settings, etc., within the HackerRank platform to align with the organization's needs and preferences. ## Developer A developer role is intended for software developers or technical managers, allowing them to: - Create and edit questions, tests, and reports. - Use HackerRank Interview to conduct interviews (if on an enterprise plan). However, developers cannot send test invitations. ## Interviewer The interviewer role provides limited access and focuses on the interview process. Interviewers can: - Create and edit questions in the library. - Conduct technical interviews via HackerRank Interview. - View candidate reports shared with them. **Note:** Interviewers do not have access to tests. ## Recruiter A recruiter role grants full access to the platform, including the ability to: - Create and edit tests, questions, and reports. - Send invitations to candidates. - Recruiters on an enterprise plan can also use HackerRank Interview to create and conduct interviews. - Create events on Engage if you have Engage platform subscription. As a company admin, you can assign and modify the entitlements for the above user roles using the [Flexible User Roles](https://support.hackerrank.com/hc/en-us/articles/28560536309395-Flexible-User-Roles)** **functionality.  \

# Grant Team Admin Access Prerequisites Granting Team Admin access

_Last updated: Feb 19, 2026, 1:56 PM (Last updated 2 months ago)_

Team Admin access allows a user to manage specific teams within your company.

A Team Admin can:

- Add existing users to the team and assign roles.

- Remove team members from the team.

- Configure team-level settings, such as changing department, region, or team name.

**Note:** Only Company Admins can add new users to the platform. For more information, see [📄 Invite a New User](/articles/9482219268).

# Pause Subscription

_Last updated: Mar 6, 2026, 12:18 AM (Last updated 2 months ago)_

The **Pause Subscription** feature allows individual self-serve plan subscribers to temporarily pause their HackerRank subscription instead of canceling it. This feature enables you to resume your subscription whenever needed, ensuring flexibility and uninterrupted access when required.

### Prerequisites

To use the **Pause Subscription** feature, ensure the following conditions are met:

1.  You must have an active subscription that started at least 30 days ago.

    - This includes accounts in a renewal grace period (7 days) due to a late recurring payment.

2.  You must have a **monthly subscription** for one of the following plans:

    - Individual Monthly - Basic

    - Interview Monthly

text: # Report Settings _Last updated: Dec 26, 2024, 3:19 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_ You can set up or change your preferences for the Microsoft Excel CSV reports generated for the candidates. These reports can be downloaded from the Test Reports page. The preferences you set here are reflected in the Microsoft Excel CSV reports you downloaded from the HackerRank platform. ## Accessing Report Settings - On the top right corner of your HackerRank account home page, you can access Settings.  - You can find the Report Settings placed on the left pane under User settings on the settings page.  ## Components of Report Settings Report settings are divided into six sections, each with fields you can select or unselect by ticking the check box attached to it. ### Candidate In this section, you can select the candidate fields you want to include in your report sheets, such as their Email, ID, Name, Tag, and IP Address. ### Company This section allows you to include your Company ID and Company Name in your reports. ### Test  There are several fields in the Test section. The definitions of each field are given in the table below to help you better understand when choosing an option.   | | | |----|----| | **Term ** | **Definition** | | Invite ID | Invitation ID is generated while inviting a Candidate.  | | Invite Method | Method of Invitation  | | Invite Valid From | The date and time from which the Invitation allowed the candidate to take part in a test. | | Invite Valid To | The date and time when the Invitation gets invalid.  | | Invited At | Time of the Invitation | | Invited By Email | Email of the recruiter who invited the Candidate.  | | Invited By Name | Name of the recruiter who invited the Candidate.  | | Role | the test is created for.   | | Test Duration | The duration set for the Test.  | | Test ID | The ID of the particular Test.  | | Test Name | Name given to the Test | | Test Owner Email | Email of the Test creator.  | | Test Owner Name | Creator of the Test. | | Test Tags | Tags given for the Test.  |

# Time Zone Settings

_Last updated: Dec 13, 2024, 5:06 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

## Overview

You can change your time zone settings to reflect the time zone in which you are located. By default, HackerRank selects the time zone based on your location while creating the account. This article will walk you through the steps in modifying the Time Zone settings.

## Modifying the Time Zone Settings

1.  Click on the arrow next to the user icon on the top right corner of the home page.

2.  Click on the **Settings** option from the drop-down menu that appears.

text: # Update or Reset Password Updating password Resetting password _Last updated: Feb 23, 2026, 12:33 PM (Last updated 2 months ago)_ You can change your password at any time to keep your account secure. Use a combination of letters, numbers, and special characters for added security. # Updating password To update a password: 1. Log in to **HackerRank for Work** using your credentials. 2. Select your profile icon in the upper-right corner. 3. Select **Settings** from the drop-down menu. 4. In the **Change Password** section, enter your current password, new password, and retype your new password to confirm. 5. Click **Save**. **Note:** If you forget your current password, use the **Forgot Password** option on the login page to reset it. # Resetting password To reset a forgotten password: 1. Go to the [HackerRank for Work](https://www.hackerrank.com/work/login) login page. 2. Click **Forgot Password?** under the password field. 3. Enter the work email address associated with your account. 4. Click **Next**. 5. Check your email for a password reset link from HackerRank. 6. Follow the instructions in the email to create a new password. \

# Email Notifications

_Last updated: Dec 26, 2024, 3:12 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

You can adjust email notification preferences for your HackerRank account by following these steps:

#### Accessing Email Notification Settings

1.  Click the **arrow** next to the user icon in the top-right corner of the home page.

2.  From the drop-down menu, select **Settings**, and then choose **Email Notifications** in the left navigation pane.

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1735206141671-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=KGEgLgkfJ9XHUN-sX8QjM6oqmlbEh0qd6gMpIXk3oCgM4dAzAKvLS1nKeh3-sEn2g0CqhTh1U-~jUcwS64WR-U6QOQkMbGO63oK9VO6KuiD8hXBQHb3XsmF-ZZVL51yNjpELQejITg2dC7xhhfDiC~04XDsEtPwBY3sHTLnZR8T1yzziKtVyoUaC3tKQjAn24W-XtTASK2KVeJ6irc9xdgiN1ywuHyYOxFW-tv1A6I7EN0MZuj1Izzk92KAa5ySocrLkQb638HZMsNwxhmIYvljjnOqyM1c068IP97dd5zjA6ae2HcY3tX1yJFvlE63vGwIQ~-jsA3f2N8lowDKY8w__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

#### Configuring Test Notifications

- **Default Setting**: You will receive an email notification after a candidate completes a test.

- **Custom Options**:

  - Disable notifications for test completions.

  - Enable notifications only if a candidate's score exceeds the cutoff score.

  **Tip**: Specify the cutoff score in a test's **Advanced Setting**. For details, refer to the [Modifying Score Settings for Tests](#) article.

#### Configuring Interview Notifications

- Enable or disable the option to send an email when an interview ends automatically.\
  **Default**: Disabled.

# HackerRank's Approach to Accessibility

_Last updated: Jan 3, 2025, 4:46 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

At HackerRank, accessibility is an integral part of our software development process. We are committed to creating inclusive experiences that empower everyone to access and use our platform effortlessly. From the earliest design decisions to final testing, we ensure our products meet accessibility standards and provide a seamless user experience. We create products that work for everyone by identifying and addressing barriers early.

### **Proactive Testing and Audits**

- **Regular Audits**: We conduct internal and external audits, ensuring alignment with accessibility standards.

- **Tools and Technology**: We leverage tools like **Axe** for automated testing & **NVDA** and **Voiceover** for manual testing.

## **Prioritizing and Addressing Issues**

Accessibility is an ongoing process. Issues are prioritized based on their impact, ensuring critical challenges are resolved first.

- **Critical**: Block access to core functionality. This is resolved with the highest urgency.

- **Serious**: Significantly hinder access but allow alternative paths. These are prioritized right after critical issues.

- **Moderate and Low**: These cause minor inconveniences or fail technical criteria without affecting usability. We address these as part of our long-term roadmap.

This approach ensures we address the most pressing needs while steadily improving our platform.

## **Third-Party Components**

While we strive to address accessibility challenges proactively, we rely on certain third-party components for specific functionalities. Fixes for third-party components are often beyond our direct control, and hence, third-party components are excluded from our accessibility scope unless an accessible alternative is available.

## **Accommodation options**

Limitations posed by third-party components or intricate technical constraints may prevent immediate resolution. In such cases, we provide in-product [accommodation options](https://support.hackerrank.com/hc/en-us/articles/360032485533-Adding-Extra-Time-for-Candidates#:~:text=The%20Time%20Accommodation%20button%20is,reflected%20in%20the%20invite%20template) and dedicated support to ensure users can effectively achieve their objectives.

## **Commitment to Continuous Improvement**

We continuously evaluate and refine our processes to align with evolving accessibility standards and user needs.

- Through each audit and review cycle, we identify areas for improvement, address potential gaps, and enhance usability.

- By investing in tools, training, and internal processes, we prioritize accessibility in our continuously evolving products.

\
For inquiries or to access our latest Accessibility Conformance Reports, please contact us at [accessibility@hackerrank.com](mailto:accessibility@hackerrank.com).

\
\

# HackerRank SkillUp Licenses

_Last updated: Dec 13, 2024, 5:06 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

## SkillUp 

SkillUp is a comprehensive platform designed to help organizations manage and develop their technical talent effectively. It offers a range of features and tools to support developers and employers in their growth, workforce planning, and talent mobility efforts.

## Licenses For SkillUp

HackerRank SkillUp offers the following user license types:

- Platform License

- Org License 

- Individual License

Each license type provides access to specified features and functionality within SkillUp. All licenses must be assigned to individual named users within your organization.

## Platform License

The Platform License provides access to all the SkillUp features and functionality included with both an Org License and an Individual License. Access to functionality is granted through SkillUp Org and SkillUp Individual licenses.

## Org License 

The Org License provides users with access to the following features:

- View company overview

- View company talent directory

- Export Individual User details from the talent directory

- Assign goals to Individual Users

- View the Skill Profile of all individual users

- Add users 

- Export the list of individual users in user management

- View and store certification assessments for use in connection with SkillUp

- View raw reports on certification assessments

Org Licenses are intended for use by Admin, Managers, and Executives. Admin users are granted access to a corresponding Recruiter license in the HackerRank platform to facilitate their use of SkillUp.

## Individual License

The Individual License provides users with access to the following features:

- Explore the role directory and skills directory

- Execute learning plans

- Take skill badging assessments and role certification assessments

- Download Role Certificates

- Manage their Skill Profile

Individual Licenses are generally intended for use by individual developers within your organization who will access the skills development features of SkillUp.

# Audit Logs in SkillUp How to request audit logs

_Last updated: Jan 28, 2026, 10:13 AM (Last updated 3 months ago)_

Audit Logs provide a detailed record of organizational activity in SkillUp. Organizations can use audit logs to support governance, security monitoring, and compliance requirements.

Audit logs capture key events performed within SkillUp, including:

- User additions, removals, and role changes

- Badge, certification, and assignment-related actions

- Administrative configuration changes

The information included in an audit log varies based on the request and the selected time period.

# How to request audit logs

To request audit logs, contact the SkillUp Support team at [skillup-support@hackerrank.com](mailto:skillup-support@hackerrank.com).

**Note:** Only administrators can request audit logs for a SkillUp account. This restriction ensures that only authorized users can access organization-wide data.

## Sample template

You can use the following template to request audit logs:

***Subject:*** *Request for SkillUp audit logs*

\

*Hello SkillUp Support Team,*

*I am requesting Audit Logs for our organization’s SkillUp account to support internal audit and compliance requirements.*

*Request details:*

- *Organization name: \[Your organization name\]*

- *Requested time period: \[start date – end date\]*

- *Relevant event types (if applicable): \[Categories of events to include. For example, user authentication, administrative actions, or assignments\]*

*Thank you for your assistance.*

*Kind regards,\
\[Your full name\]\
\[Your role/title\]\
\[Your organization\]\
\[Work email address\]*

**Note:** If you have questions about audit logs or are unsure what information to provide, contact [skillup-support@hackerrank.com](mailto:skillup-support@hackerrank.com).

\

# Get Started with Certify

_Last updated: Apr 23, 2025, 11:51 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

The Certify experience in SkillUp enables developers to confidently work toward and earn certifications in key roles. It provides a clear, guided path through practical, untimed challenges that build the skills needed for success.

## Intended audience

The Certify experience is designed for: 

- Individual developers who want to demonstrate their capabilities through hands-on certifications.

- Organizations that aim to validate internal skill development and promote talent readiness.

## Using Certify

To begin using the Certify experience:

1.  Log in to **SkillUp** using your credentials.

2.  Go to the **Certify** tab.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1745153743788-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=Qe8dQsYz5YIRV8OvIzO0DM82sEs7KPWN8lDEoX7SLI0TPrVAwqUkGjlpZetH1-sx60bwO3-Yri4GS-eUzw4S8e5UIn14SGmk82H4JJmfSGVc~VAEmkHwFfB5Y64flNw1RhZtOYHEEiJXvFbd3bMAAKXrOTN5a6cIv0SSZpDFBwxFO-RiJej39CJpZNMXwV0ZDqEaqJygoNam2JamwR7KWpDb1scoDGfxBPJ5K6kMfF8dLHWyVPMVSBQU~j5zP9gl0s-XRqRT8M48k8e7-F-qO8yhAJf5CA8jRqnJhliQK1SApLBV~hSxx0S1S3gljEET23KEtbUNRUxYIm2esZjSsw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

3.  Select a role certification track (for example, *Frontend Developer - React*).

4.  Review the list of required practice challenges.

5.  Solve each practice challenge at your own pace. The AI tutor is available for support during practice.

6.  Complete all required practice challenges to unlock the certification assessment.

7.  Attempt the certification when you are ready.

**Note:** Certification is a timed assessment conducted on the HackerRank platform.

## Common use cases

- A developer preparing to transition into a specialized frontend role, such as Angular development, wants to demonstrate their capabilities.

- An employee aiming for internal mobility uses certifications to validate readiness for a new role.

- A manager encourages team members to earn certifications that align with organizational skill goals.

## Best practices

To get the most out of the Certify experience:

- Take your time with practice challenges. Use the AI tutor to fully understand the problems.

- Practice in short, consistent sessions instead of completing everything at once.

- Use the sample environment to get familiar with the certification test format.

- Track your progress to ensure all required practice challenges are completed before attempting certification.

## Known limitations

The following limitations apply to the current experience:

- The AI tutor is not available during the certification assessment.

- Certifications are time-bound and can only be reattempted after a cooldown period.

## FAQs

**Can I attempt the certification directly?**

No. You must complete the required practice challenges before unlocking the certification.

**What happens if I fail the certification?**

You can reattempt the certification after the cooldown period ends.

**Is the AI tutor available during the certification test?**

No. The AI tutor is only available during practice challenges.

**Can I download or share my certificate?**

Yes. After passing the certification, you can download and share your certificate from your SkillUp profile.

\
title: Get Started with Certify

text:
# ‭Reporting APIs Available endpoints Configuring reporting APIs‬ Error handling Best practices Rate limits

_Last updated: Oct 14, 2025, 9:05 PM (Last updated 6 months ago)_

SkillUp’s Reporting APIs allow you to programmatically extract skill signals, badges, and certification data from your organization. These APIs enable you to integrate learning insights with HR systems, build customized reports, and connect learning outcomes to business impact.

**Note:** Only administrators can generate credentials to access these APIs.

# Available endpoints

|  |  |
|----|----|
| **Endpoint** | **Description** |
| Credentials API | Returns a list of all available badges and certifications in SkillUp. |
| Users API | Returns user data, including learning progress, badges, and certifications achieved. |

# Configuring reporting APIs‬

SkillUp APIs use the **OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials** flow for secure access. Only authorized systems can request and retrieve reporting information.

To configure reporting APIs:

## ‭Step 1: Generate OAuth Credentials‬

![ReportingAPIs (2).gif](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1760426646769-ReportingAPIs%25282%2529.gif?Expires=253370764800&Signature=avWPKb67QURKfzp-9Nd3HGyLRI9LsjwsKxojUbqSWczAMTa6SQ9xa1MZff3QdRXUd--A3fKLJCqmBCB1Y3a1fsaUM0WTjSgMC9NbONDRfBsmSLKxfg6WVOZtsL-5lnvt-N7IWaHSQ~uncnPmFRdswrMbJ8ou21TU58J4x-T~~zhNWKazWx8xv21NjYkEXfLVAUfppmSW3-IKsnk2IG3TMymLMVH-10-AuO2icwH0JuzXKzbhSqamF5KgEJSRqtpdhEVyGXOwgQUfR4Nx6FqOc8-KRnt1E1pQDPpvVTyUngYmh81nIbkWnXol-SdVucX3RtcYcAUwlTz-pB~1TZl7Hw__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

1.  ‭Log in to **SkillUp** using an administrator account.

2.  Click your profile icon in the upper-right corner and select **Settings**.

3.  Click **Register New Application**.

4.  Enter a name for your application.

5.  Click **Register Application**.

6.  Copy the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** to the clipboard or click **Download JSON** to save the credentials as a file.

    **Important Note:** The client secret is displayed only once during generation. You must store it securely before closing the dialog because you cannot retrieve it again.

Your application is now successfully registered, and you can start making API requests.

## ‭Step 2: Request Access Token‬

‭As a security measure, you must first obtain an access token by making a POST request to the` /v1/oauth2/token` endpoint.

The Authorization header must include your client credentials encoded in Base64 format.

1.  Combine your client ID and client secret using a colon (:).\
    Example: `client_id:client_secret`

2.  Encode the string using Base64.

3.  Add the prefix `Basic`to the encoded string to create the Authorization header.\
    Example: `Basic <base64_encoded_string>`.

**Note:** The access token (JWT) is valid for **10 minutes**. When it expires, repeat these steps to request a new token.

heading: Example
text: *Note:** The access token (JWT) is valid for **10 minutes**. When it expires, repeat these steps to request a new token. ### Example Plain Text ``` If client_id = "abc123" and client_secret = "def456" Combined: “abc123:def456” Base64 encoded:”YWJjMTIzOmRlZjQ1Ng==” Final header:”Basic YWJjMTIzOmRlZjQ1Ng==” ``` **Request** Shell ``` curl -X POST https://www.hackerrank.com/skillup/api/v1/oauth2/token \ -H "Authorization: Basic " \ -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \ -d "grant_type=client_credentials" ``` **Headers** | | | | |---------------|--------------|--------------------------------------| | **Header** | **Required** | **Value** | | Authorization | Yes | Basic `` | | Content-Type | Yes | application/x-www-form-urlencoded | **Body parameters** | | | | |---------------|--------------|--------------------| | **Parameter** | **Required** | **Value** | | grant_type | Yes | client_credentials | **Response** JSON ``` { "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...", "expires_in": 600 } ``` | | | | |--------------|----------|------------------------------------------------| | **Field** | **Type** | **Description** | | access_token | string | The access token for API authentication | | expires_in | integer | Token validity period in seconds (600 seconds) | ## ‭Step 3: Access SkillUp APIs‬ ‭After you obtain a valid access token, use it to call the SkillUp Reporting APIs. Include the token in the Authorization header of your request. ### Example Request Shell ``` curl -X GET https://www.hackerrank.com/skillup/api/v2/credentials \ -H "Authorization: Bearer " ``` # Error handling | | | | |-----------------|-------------------|----------------------------------------| | **Status Code** | **Error** | **Description** | | 400 | Bad Request | Missing or invalid parameters | | 401 | Unauthorized | Access token is invalid or expired | | 403 | Forbidden | Token lacks required permissions | | 429 | Too Many Requests | Too many requests made in a short time | # Best practices - Store credentials securely. Never expose client credentials in client-side code. - Tokens remain valid for 10 minutes. Cache and reuse access tokens instead of generating new ones for every request - Request a new token before the current one expires. # Rate limits | | | |------------------|----------------------| | **Request Type** | **Limit** | | Token requests | 1 request per second | | API requests | 1 request per second | For more information, contact [skillup-support@hackerrank.com](mailto:skillup-support@hackerrank.com).‭

# Custom Certifications

_Last updated: Jul 30, 2025, 9:55 AM (Last updated 9 months ago)_

Custom Certifications let you convert any test created in HackerRank for Work into a SkillUp certification experience. These certifications mirror the experience of standard SkillUp assessments, but your team fully owns the content. 

Standard Certifications may not align with your tech stack or internal standards. With Custom Certifications, you can build assessments that reflect your team’s real-world challenges and complement existing SkillUp content.

![Custom Certification.gif](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1753767345737-CustomCertification.gif?Expires=253370764800&Signature=f-t3HYPu~hGVh1T6YVzwNFPggZSPhPu4U6X4udbtbXwTItE-RybfozAY9jyNgx2Lfoz0a9rUC-HWduAyTdaLooLC0UFVZJT~8wZxEf3jXdCNQOsZ4XGs7ZatqqFwEsoumW~9aoFmlu-k5l7mcnuDqKiSQ-bxqcsiucUbBjgF5sQrhDyuu6f0u23qB66pBvLe~BLoZ9WqUBY7YcCZYAYAJzr~XPxYZe0~Z3s3J8JFmfe3u6phre0FNLCOH9YDBbSuTdS2vjwzsjavr6eDLhFsiLrT4H08y2nwC~IdQw0wzrldqBy3vuS0Ije2TuU8LM7dwtwlEi530HTD0K~UXpxVaQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

Companies increasingly build skills-based mobility programs and invest in internal talent development. Whether you prepare junior developers for advancement or reskill engineers in new domains such as cloud, AI, or full-stack development, Certifications help you measure progress with clarity and rigor.

## Intended audience

The Custom Certification is designed for: 

- Engineering leaders or learning and development (L&D) teams who design structured learning and certification paths

- Platform owners or HackerRank for Work administrators who manage test content and track outcomes

- Developers and employees who participate in internal upskilling or mobility programs

- Enterprise customers who build custom skill frameworks and signals alongside SkillUp’s standard certifications

## Best practices

To get the most out of Custom Certification:

- Use hands-on, real-world problems to measure skills objectively

- Pair the certification with a recommended SkillUp Learn track so developers can practice in advance.

## Known limitations

- You need support from HackerRank to activate a test for a SkillUp certification. After you prepare the test in HackerRank for Work, contact your account manager or [support@hackerrank.com](mailto:support@hackerrank.com).

- Library content restrictions apply. You can only use questions available in your HackerRank library, or you can create custom questions.\

text: # Accessing SkillUp Employer Platform _Last updated: Apr 3, 2025, 12:33 PM (Last updated 1 year ago)_ The SkillUp platform for employers consolidates skill-level data in a single portal. To access: 1. Log in to your HackerRank account. 2. Navigate to the top menu and click on **Hire**. 3. Select **SkillUp** from the dropdown menu. The platform consists of two main pages: **Overview** and **Talent**. ## Overview Page This section provides a graphical representation of your organization’s certified roles and skills. ### Key Components - **Company Overview**: Displays metrics for certified developers, assessed developers, and onboarded managers. It also tracks certifications and skill badges earned within your organization. - **Role Certification Funnel**: Click on a role to see a detailed breakdown of employee certifications with the ability to download the data. - **Certification Trends**: View certification trends over time, filtered by specific roles or periods. - **Engagement and Assessment Trends**: View engagement and Assessment trends over time, filtered by certifications and badges. - **Track Developer Actions:** On the Developers Onboqarded dashboard, you can track the details such as: - Number of developers invited - Number of developers signed up - Number of developers attempted to get a badge or certification - Number of developers who completed a badge or certification ![Overview Page SkillUp.gif](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1742288486731-OverviewPageSkillUp.gif?Expires=253370764800&Signature=CZofqdvPDD7UCB2rI38mBkw4VsXzKOg8IlNPiMhFEJBhiJVwzFASOrOcsrtBvn~XJ-3Rrg11dslYTtFHqgFili9vvFvfClw15-ZSO4cl2UtJcHjz0k43zKHc-jKJkE5v~fH6BnyCSGVvd9TLPczArJHxhD5A5XZq74ybvVY7JgZMGJxj~tzilv2EjaJjGghptztvqLtXUWYi4VJBrt42JWayUlx80HIwQzOTEB2uccWSF6Xgpw7mMzbs0Jv3izwiOqVb2b37Rl0Xjfr4PpMswO0y47sXm65ayst~LhlK7VJ5doZ3v1x3TVkv60jSmNixAayngtEQt3OIXxlNMkMEuA__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46) ## Talent Directory The Talent directory helps organize your developers based on **Designation**, **Certifications**, and **Skills Proficiency**. ### Features - Use filters to narrow down employees by **Job Titles**, **Certifications**, **Skills**, or **Managers**. - Click the **Export **button to export the data. # HackerRank SkillUp

_Last updated: Dec 13, 2024, 4:58 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_

### Introduction to SkillUp

SkillUp is a solution to support internal upskilling and mobility within your organization. It allows individuals to assess their skill proficiency and receive personalized learning plans for developing skills relevant to their current or future roles. 

Skill development is validated through badges and role certifications, ensuring employees and organizations can track growth. For employers, SkillUp offers a comprehensive view of the skill inventory within the organization, aiding in workforce planning by identifying strengths and skill gaps.

### SkillUp Use Cases

SkillUp creates value for employers and employees by providing visibility into your workforce's current and future state, enabling data-driven development.

### For Employers

- **Workforce Planning**: Gain insight into your organization’s skills distribution. Use this data to understand workforce strengths and gaps, supporting effective upskilling initiatives.

- **Talent Certification**: Accurately certify current skill levels, eliminating assumptions and guesswork. Use this data to make informed decisions about workforce development.

- **Learning and Development Tracking**: Monitor the progress and effectiveness of learning programs using comprehensive reporting tools to ensure continuous improvement.

- **Internal Mobility**: Identify potential Employees for internal job roles by reviewing verified skill profiles and progress in development. This feature can support career advancement and reduce employee turnover.

### For Developers

#### **Upskilling Resources**

- **Vast Learning Library:** Access a comprehensive library of learning materials, including courses, tutorials, and hands-on projects. These resources are tailored to enhance your skills across various roles and technologies, helping you upskill and benchmark your proficiency.

- **Verified Skill Profiles:** Create and maintain a verified skill profile on **SkillUp**. This profile highlights your proficiencies, achievements, and technical expertise, giving a comprehensive overview of your skills.

- **Curated Learning Paths: SkillUp provides customized learning paths b**ased on your current skill level, career goals, and organizational needs. These pathways ensure efficient, targeted skill development aligned with your growth and organizational objectives.

By leveraging **SkillUp**, developers can take charge of their skill development, earn credentials, and explore internal mobility opportunities. Employers can make informed decisions about technical talent, drive upskilling initiatives, and ensure a skilled, productive workforce aligned with business objectives.

heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text:
## Frequently Asked Questions

**How is a proficiency level determined?**

Skill Ratings determine the proficiency level. HackerRank determines the cut-offs for each proficiency in a skill-based on inputs from SMEs and how the top 10% of the employees have scored in a particular assessment that determines the skill proficiency.

In the case of custom assessments (tailored to meet the organization's requirements), the organizations set the cut-offs.

**What if I take multiple assessments that assess the same skill?**

The Skill Rating would be based on the results from the most recent assessment taken. This will help us keep the Skill Rating accurate and up-to-date to enable your decision-making process.

**How can I access past Skill Ratings?**

In the profile of an employee, you can go to the Skill Details section to see the progress of Skill Ratings over a period of time.

**How many retakes are allowed for an assessment?**

The employer will determine the number of retakes for each assessment based on their policies.

The cool-down period is determined as the days to pass before taking the next retake.  

**What is the difference between Skill Ratings and Badges?**

Skill Rating is a quantitative indicator of an individual's proficiency in technical skills.

Badges, on the other hand, are a way of acknowledging an achievement or a skill acquisition at a skill proficiency level. You can receive a badge when you have taken an assessment and reached proficiency level.

For example, If you take a Java assessment and achieve the required Skill Rating for expert proficiency, you will receive the Java (Expert) ^ badge.

**What happens to my skill rating if the assessment is retired or updated?**

If an assessment is deleted from HRW, it is considered retired. You will continue to see the assessment scores in the Assessment History, but your Skill Rating will reflect the most recent Rating before the retired assessment.

If the content of an assessment changes, it is considered updated. However, your skill rating will not be affected if an assessment is updated. 

**How can I add custom learning resources to SkillUp?**

You must provide an Excel sheet with the links to custom learning resources like Pluralsight videos or Udacity courses. Within two business days, the HackerRank team will manually add these links to the relevant skills. In the future, you can add custom resources through the admin dashboard. 

**Can I influence the content in certification assessments? **

No, you cannot influence or customize the content in the certification assessments. Hackerrank is taking a strategic bet on AI-first learning and will invest in providing guided, immersive AI tutors for each skill and role. The certification content will be Hackerrank's proprietary AI-powered assessments.

**What is the difference between a badge and a certification? **

A badge is earned for demonstrating proficiency in a skill after passing a skill assessment. Certification is earned for a role that combines multiple skills after passing a comprehensive role assessment that includes prerequisites of earning the relevant skill badges. 

**Can I transfer skill badges earned outside the company (e.g., on the HackerRank community) to my employer's SkillUp account?**

You cannot transfer external skill badges into your organization's SkillUp account. SkillUp treats personal community certifications separately from professional employer certifications to maintain data privacy and boundaries.

**How often are the global in-demand skills updated on the SkillUp platform?**

text: # Get Started with Learn _Last updated: Apr 23, 2025, 11:40 AM (Last updated 1 year ago)_ The Learn experience in SkillUp offers a structured, flexible, and hands-on learning environment. It helps developers improve their technical skills through guided practice and AI-powered support.  It includes the following features: - Self-paced, contextual learning with guided examples and interactive challenges. - Real-time AI tutor to support coding practice and concept reinforcement. - Skill badges that validate proficiency and progress. ## Intended audience The Learn experience is designed for:  - Individual developers seeking to upskill in specific technologies. - Organizations aiming to promote talent growth by helping employees gain and demonstrate new skills. ## Using Learn To begin using the Learn experience: 1. Log in to **SkillUp** using your credentials. 2. Go to the **Learn** tab. 3. Select a skill (for example, Python, Angular). 4. Select a concept from the **Foundational**, **Intermediate**, or **Expert** track. 5. Read the lesson material with examples, explanations, and guidance from the AI tutor. 6. Submit your completed solution. 9. Complete all challenges in a track to earn a Skill badge. ## Common use cases - A developer preparing for a new backend role wants to refresh their Python fundamentals. - A backend engineer transitioning to a full stack position uses the React learning path to build frontend skills. - A manager encourages the employee to upskill and earn a badge to demonstrate readiness for an internal opportunity. ## Best practices To get the most out of the Learn experience: - Use the AI tutor to deepen your understanding instead of skipping directly to the challenge. - Set aside short, regular time blocks to complete modules at your own pace. ## Known limitations The following limitations apply to the current experience: - The AI tutor is available only during Learn and Badge experiences. # Weekly Challenges Accessing weekly challenges Leaderboard Evaluating weekly challenges Available weekly challenges

_Last updated: Jan 28, 2026, 10:08 AM (Last updated 3 months ago)_

Weekly Challenges are short, repeatable activities that enable users to apply skills in a focused and time-efficient manner. They complement SkillUp learning paths and certifications by offering ongoing practice rather than long-form coursework.

Weekly Challenges support the following objectives:

- Provide structured opportunities for continued learning after completing badges or certifications

- Encourage consistent participation through a predictable weekly cadence

- Introduce a controlled competitive element within an organization

**Note:** A new challenge releases every week. Challenges and leaderboards reset every Tuesday at 6:00 PM UTC. 

# Accessing weekly challenges

To access the weekly challenge: 

1.  Log in to your **SkillUp** account using your credentials. 

2.  Locate the weekly challenge banner on the right side of the homepage.

    ![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1769525879021-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=M~KMbSgH2TiZ-hTuiDsQfWmsc1K9L0Bsq6ms~jpXRS-yEy6KQ~ul1YQ97rWWTPdO~-1K9QLKsJGkkGHLXsksWrXT5SC-NILF7cE7oO2tiWIRX1E1qBlUyY6nz4JjUkGsa~O75fS4w~zfTxeAyv48c6gVNl70BlB4tSjRoUApQsM23OjjtntOwWESxJeV-YGBCsyRTz4DYBEN2qRPr4cL3QlgVFRjr0tCkX06g5HygXOHGIT9feXPYvnPia1skvST7CkO33BxeOzNYycPHfutzmOsSN4N-34lFRzwsyhCd~PMIgxpEWm7eT6GAiG~81ve4B6o2YuTMAF4SIVOsHy27g__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

The banner displays the remaining time to attempt the challenge, along with the current and previous week leaderboards.

# Leaderboard

Each weekly challenge includes a leaderboard that ranks participants within the same organization.

Leaderboards allow users to:

- Compare their submissions with peers

- Learn from top-performing solutions

- Track progress across multiple challenges

**Note:** Users can view the previous week’s challenge and winning submissions to learn from them.

![image.png](https://assets.usepylon.com/e6a58e21-be80-4777-9eaf-f73beeee94d9%2F1769525915891-image.png?Expires=253370764800&Signature=hlizgIT~Ii8nn~m1ggeHH3JWmMKUx~QjU5bixfdjLEalebfITUEPbr9qehoOePpd1DSi4kxo95BBM1tPb1ZsIQlrRPiqr87JDElfFa4l6JkxaJz2~xEOHRpI4gfnR~jIC-rnzjnEL9XlqtbT-4C-lUugorym0uzVbRCOlNKOO4I2ywVUOcnBLR1S2mAa9FXp4gQfw-pNf5MoJqE-iLiY4oG7QJ9l-aQnGf8rtA1ezZ2tvQd7UE9EorMJdgJ5hlqtmoENyJO8cSmXWZumFBnQeePRMpvkbSwtp7bHjn51b8gs-~3eHKLMoFswArWVdOugpK~qRkqhbHuBMiDrW7CqyQ__&Key-Pair-Id=K3NV4LZ47N8M46)

# Evaluating weekly challenges

Weekly Challenges use token efficiency to evaluate submissions.

*Total score = Input tokens (prompt) + Output tokens (generated code)*

- Lower scores rank higher

- If scores tie, earlier submissions rank higher

- Each user can submit once per weekly challenge

# Available weekly challenges

HackerRank currently offers the Weekly Prompt Engineering Challenge.

## Weekly Prompt Engineering challenge

The Weekly Prompt Engineering Challenge helps users improve their ability to write effective prompts for large language models (LLMs).

Prompting is a critical skill in modern development workflows. Developers interact with LLMs, agents, and AI-assisted development tools through prompts. Inefficient prompting increases cost by consuming unnecessary tokens or requiring repeated attempts.

This challenge reinforces the importance of clear, precise prompts for generating efficient and accurate results.
